faqs.question: Who is First Command?
faqs.answer_excerpt:
Founded in 1958 by a retired military officer, First Command Financial Services Inc. and its related companies are focused on helping U.S. service members and their families plan for and pursue long-term financial security.

Today, we have more than 500 Financial Advisors operating from 175+ offices across the country and abroad, most near major military installations. Their focus is on building comprehensive financial plans and serving as personal financial coaches to their clients.

faqs.question: Is First Command a fiduciary?
faqs.answer_excerpt:
Yes. A fiduciary is a person or an organization that has a legal and ethical responsibility to prudently manage money or other assets on behalf of an individual. As an investment advisory firm, First Command Advisory Services, Inc. is held to a fiduciary standard in all client relationships. That means we have an obligation to always put clientsâ interests first when providing investment advice and financial recommendations.
